sources.title: Qwen 3.5 35B-A3B | Model Dex | NeuralWire | NeuralWire
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.5 35B-A3B is Alibaba's efficiency-focused model in the Qwen 3.5 family, released February 24, 2026. Despite 35 billion total parameters, it activates only 3 billion per forward pass — an extreme sparsity ratio that makes it runnable on consumer-grade hardware with as little as 8GB VRAM while delivering performance that outpaces models with seven times its active parameter count.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 is a reasoning vision-language model that supports tool use. With 35B total parameters and 3B activated, it outperforms previous generation models more than 6x its size.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B | vLLM Recipes - recipes.vllm.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B is the smallest MoE in the Qwen3.5 family, sharing the gated delta networks architecture with 35B total parameters and 3B activated per token (256 experts).

sources.title: baa-ai/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-MINT-MLX-30GB · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Mixed-precision quantized version of Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B using MINT (Memory-Informed N-bit Tuning). MINT allocates bit-widths per-tensor via budget-constrained rate-distortion optimization — no calibration data required.
